The '''Imperial Correction Service''', also known as the '''Imperial Correctional Facilities Ministry''',<ref name="HSatCSS" /> was an organization that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to supervise and correct imperfections in certain Imperial regions. It was responsible for overseeing all prisons and correctional facilities throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The agency was headed by the [[Minister of Corrections]]. There were also [[Regional Director]]s that were a part of this organization.

Before his death, [[Gervruche]] served as Minister of Corrections. [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Chawkroft]] rose through the ranks from [[Special Projects Consultant]], to [[Assistant-Minister of Corrections]], until final reaching the post of Minister of Corrections.<ref name="HSatCSS" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Imperial Correction Service [[Imperial prison barge|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] became infected with a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|deadly virus]] while en route to the [[detainment moon]] [[Gradient Seven]], killing almost all of the crew and inmates.<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>
